description: This file contains functions for testing a shell library, including test setup, execution, comparison, and validation routines. It defines multiple functions that facilitate running sub-tests and checking their outputs, as well as managing test environments.

methods.name: write_sub_test_lib_test
methods.description: Sets up a test environment by creating a directory and writing a test script that sources the test library, then takes test code as input.

methods.name: _run_sub_test_lib_test_common
methods.description: Runs a sub-test with specified comparison operator and expected exit code, setting up environment variables and executing the test script.

methods.name: write_and_run_sub_test_lib_test
methods.description: Creates and runs a sub-test expecting success (exit code 0).

methods.name: write_and_run_sub_test_lib_test_err
methods.description: Creates and runs a sub-test expecting failure (non-zero exit code).

methods.name: _check_sub_test_lib_test_common
methods.description: Compares the output of a test script against expected output, after processing with sed.

methods.name: check_sub_test_lib_test
methods.description: Verifies the output of a test matches the expected, ensuring no errors.

methods.name: check_sub_test_lib_test_err
methods.description: Verifies the output matches the expected error output.
